Name: An Overgrown Farm
Author: KatsAtelier
Description:
This new farm map does NOT replace any existing farms. It is extremely overgrown at the start, making farming more of a challenge, and as an added bonus there is blue grass for your animals to eat...once you've cleared the land enough to get at it, of course.

There is a tree at the door to the farmhouse, you'll need to chop it to be able to go back in.

This should be compatible with all other mods including recolors, let me know if you find any conflicts.

[b]Note: [/b]All cuttable trees can be removed with an axe, you won't require bombs (I've thoroughly play-tested this mod). Some of the trees cause minor graphics glitches, once those trees are removed it looks normal again.

Downloads.Description: Removed some trees at greenhouse that were inaccessible to chop down (only applies to new save files unfortunately)
